title: The hidden workforce impacts of childcare challenges
discussion_signal: The post expands childcare difficulty beyond a simple prevented-work-hours measure, identifying reduced hours, quitting, unpaid leave, paid leave, and supervising children while working. It highlights an income gradient in access to paid leave and frames childcare as workforce infrastructure absorbed by households.
linked_research_question: How do childcare constraints convert into different work, time, income, and employer adaptations across households?
limits: The post interprets survey estimates and does not establish causality
Reported adaptations may be underreported or overlap
Audience discussion is not a representative sample of working households
